What is measured / coverage
  • CPU is ru_utime + ru_stime, summed across chunks. One CPU-hour means one core busy for one hour.
  • Read/write are Linux ru_inblock / ru_oublock × 512 bytes of accounted storage I/O (kernel accounting). They are not log sizes, syscall byte counts, or exact physical device traffic. Cached reads do not count as storage reads.
  • These are the processes accounted for by the test runner; external services, compilation, linking and later CI artifact processing are not attributed to suites here.
  • Only chunk records are summed, never case or suite summary records. Missing metrics appear as “—”; “†” means a partial sum. Measured chunks (CPU / read / write): {{ totals.cpu_seconds_chunks }} / {{ totals.read_bytes_chunks }} / {{ totals.write_bytes_chunks }} out of {{ totals.chunks }}.
  • Areas use the same TESTOWNERS matching as the test report and owner_area_mapping.json. Shared areas form one group to avoid double counting; suites without a team are “unassigned”.
  • Percentages use measured test usage in this try as the denominator, not all host activity. Suite shares show “all suites / own area”. CSV and JSON retain seconds, bytes and per-metric coverage.
